Oblique approach / entrance and adjacent bay
Wide drawing lens includes head and adjacent pier; gameplay FOV remains 90°.
AXIAL HALL CONTEXT

OPEN PARALLEL DRAWING
+Y half / selected enclosing faces omitted
Vertical continuity
The tall jamb stays continuous to the head.
A 1.6 m return puts the thin glazing behind
a substantial stone edge; a 0.6 m inner step
makes the reveal legible on approach.
A separated terminal joint
The 1.0 m wide shoulder sits behind the
portal and engaged pier. The long beam
lands on the end pier; the upper wall
steps back 0.6 m above the beam.
One quiet side-bay pocket
A deep perimeter frames the side soffit.
The 4 m floor aisle and crossover stay.
The head zone remains thin at 0.2 m;
hidden construction is unresolved.
